drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:sell-what-the-pursuit-makes row: input_schema and steps find, pick and prices with their submit shapes); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:sell-what-the-pursuit-makes for pursuit:sourdough-baking: find what my baking already produces and pick the first thing to offer."
no_lists_because: The workflow reads the pursuit and the person's own files and starts a price experiment through tools; it names no list in its words, input or steps.
instructions: 1. Say "Run workflow:sell-what-the-pursuit-makes" with pursuit_id set to the pursuit whose byproducts you want to sell; leave it out and it takes your biggest pursuit.
2. Step find reads the pursuit and your files, recordings, posts and tools that came out of it, and lists every byproduct with where it is.
3. Step pick says who would pay for each, the evidence (people asking, similar things selling) and whether selling it would pull the pursuit off course, then picks the first one to offer.

4. Step prices chooses two or more prices (one low enough that most who want it can get in) and starts an experiment with tool:choose-what-a-visitor-sees; the winner is read from payments. If the offer does not exist yet it is drafted for your approval first and nothing is charged or published without it.

worked_examples.title: Three byproducts of a baking pursuit
worked_examples.ask: What does my baking already make that people would pay for?
worked_examples.given: Read from the step in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (byproducts need at least 1 item, each with what and where). Synthetic files of the pursuit: a notes folder, a camera roll of bakes and a spreadsheet of hydration tests.
